title: Namaz for Settling urgent Needs
data:
You may offer a four-unit prayer with precise Qunut and other pillars (i.e. genuflection (ruku'), prostration, and the other parts of prayers). In the first unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah one time and repeat the following verses seventy times:
حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ.
HASBUNAL LAAHU WA NI'MAL WAKEEL.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Protector.
In the second unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:
مَا شَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ اِنْ تَرَنِ اَنَا اَقَلَّ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَ وَلَدًا.
MAA SHAA-AL LAAHU LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BIL LAAHI IN TARANI ANAA AQALLA MINKA MAALAN WA WALADAA.
(It is) as Allah has willed; there is no power save in Allah. If you consider me to be inferior to you in wealth and children...
In the third unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:
لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّى كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ.
LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA SUBHAANAKA INNEE KUNTU MINAZ ZAALIMEEN.
There is no god but You, glory be to You; surely I have been of the wrongdoers.
In the fourth unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:
اُفَوِّضُ اَمْرِىْ اِلَى اللهِ اِنَّ اللهَ بَصِيْرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ.
UFAWWIZU AMREE ILAL LAAHI INNAL LAAHA BASEERUN BIL 'IBAAD.
I entrust my affair to Allah; surely Allah sees the servants.
You may then mention your need.
